checks.note: handleOAuthCallback's P18 check (line 68) indeed accepts any state equal to the coach's UUID with no nonce, but confirming the exploit requires StripeOnboardingService.generateOnboardingUrl (to verify state is the bare coachId), routes.js/CoachPublicProfilePage (to verify coachIds are public), and the auth mechanism (cookie vs bearer) — none shown here.

StripeOnboardingService.handleOAuthCallback does run the OAuth exchange outside the @Transactional upsert, so the race window exists, but the claimed consequence depends on StripeWebhookService.java (the account.updated branch with findByStripeAccountId(...).ifPresent(...) and its 2xx acknowledgement), which was not provided and could not be read in this session.

AccountManagementFacade.sendMail (publisher.publishEvent(envelope), ~line 207) does publish the Envelope purely in-memory with no persistence, matching the producer-side claim; but the loss window depends on MailManager.sendEmailFromTemplate's AFTER_COMMIT/async persistence timing and EmailRetryScheduler's query, neither of which is in the provided code, and the verification caveat cannot be run.

generateReport commits the row as PENDING_UPLOAD (saveAndFlush) and hands pdfBytes only to an AFTER_COMMIT @Async("reportExecutor") listener (onReportGenerated), which is the sole transition out of PENDING_UPLOAD; a restart in that window strands the row, listReports filters to READY only, and the handler's own Javadoc confirms no retry — the finding's grep found no sweeper, consistent with this file.

AccountManagementFacade.registerAccount indeed does an unguarded find-then-insert (findUserByEmailOrLogin line 131, persistUser line 151) with no catch, but the finding's consequence depends on whether UserRegistrationService.createUser (or a global exception handler) catches DataIntegrityViolationException and reroutes to the user-exists path — that code is not provided, so the 500/anti-enumeration claim cannot be settled from this file.

startUpload re-reads props.drill.id for updateDrillVideoState after `await runTusUpload(...)`, with no captured id, no watch on props.drill, and abort only in onUnmounted; the comment above the useDrillVideoPlayback call confirms the panel is reused without remount as props.drill swaps, so a mid-upload drill switch marks the new drill hasVideo:true.

The in-file mechanism holds: onMounted is the sole call site of fetchVideoUploadEligibility, gated on props.drill?.libraryType === 'PRIVATE', with no watch on props.drill, and the useDrillVideoPlayback comment confirms the panel is reused without remount. But the finding's verification caveat — that DrillLibraryPage/SessionBuilderPage mounts the panel with drill=null before selection — and whether canUploadVideo is set elsewhere in session.store depend on files not shown here.

EmailRegistrationStrategy.sendEmail (line ~146) does derive the Envelope's final constructor arg and helpCode from ShortCode.shortenInt(UUID.randomUUID().hashCode()), so the identifier space is at most 2^32 (hashCode returns int) — the trigger is real. But the claimed consequence (MailManager treating this as the dedup key and overwriting a prior envelope's status/recipients on collision) depends on MailManager, Envelope, ShortCode.shortenInt, and the envelope_entity.send_id constraint, none of which are shown here.

ReportGenerationService.saveBranding shows the exact find-or-new-then-save pattern described (findById(coachId).orElseGet(CoachBranding::new) then save, assigned ID, no lock), but the finding's verification caveat requires CoachBranding (@Id/@Version) and CoachBrandingRepository (possible overridden save or ON CONFLICT upsert), neither of which is provided, so the race cannot be confirmed or refuted from this file alone.
